versions.changelog: Penny-permanent pricing: images 1MB and under are now free AND permanent; up to 10MB free for 30 days, or permanent for $0.01 USDC. Size is no longer a paid feature (10MB on every tier). Updated rate limits and expiresAt semantics.
Link img402.dev in the skill intro (clickable reference).
Added 'Public access' warning section noting that uploaded images are reachable by anyone with the URL. No behavior change.
Added $1 / permanent retention tier (POST /api/upload/token/permanent). Updated 'Pick a tier' table to show all three tiers with example use cases.

- Initial release: upload images to img402.dev and receive a public URL.
- Free tier: images up to 1MB, 7-day retention, supports PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, no authentication required.
- Provides ready-to-use curl commands for quick uploads.
- Includes resizing tips for large images and details on rate limits.
- Paid tier option: longer retention (1 year) and larger images (up to 5MB) via x402 token.
